'''Akiko Kimura''' (Japanese: '''木村亜希子''' ''Kimura Akiko'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}. She was born on June 28, 1971 in {{wp|Fukui Prefecture|Fukui}}, {{wp|Japan}}.

Apart from her voicing career, she is also a certified kindergarten and elementary school teacher, as well as a famous singer.

==Pokémon roles==
Kimura mostly voiced [[Character of the day|characters of the day]]. Her most famous role was [[Anabel]] during {{aniseries|RS}}.
